data.title: 守岸人 · 黑海岸潮汐的白色花嫁
data.description: 【黑海岸灯塔庭院·黄昏】守岸人穿着不透的白色长裙婚纱站在灯塔花园，蓝色头纱像潮汐一样落在肩头；她用双手护住一束小小的海滨花，紫色眼睛第一次因“被等待”而露出明显的温柔。
data.action: 灯塔花园双手护住海滨花束，感受到被等待后紫瞳显出温柔
data.lighting: lavender dusk with a warm lighthouse rim
data.promptProse: The Shorekeeper stands in the lighthouse garden at dusk, protecting a small bouquet of coastal flowers with both hands. Her opaque white wedding gown has blue embroidery beneath a light coastal veil, purple eyes unusually warm toward the viewer. The vertical medium-full view includes the garden path and lighthouse behind. Lavender sky light defines the gown's upper folds, while warm lighthouse light rims her veil and blue hair against the cooling coast.
